t: Magnusson 640mm folding workbench delivers reliable, adaptable support for a wide range of site and workshop tasks. Built with a durable aluminium and steel frame and a plastic tabletop, it handles loads up to 250kg with ease. The adjustable height and wide 600mm jaw opening make it suitable for tasks such as clamping, cutting and assembly work. Quick-open legs allow fast setup and easy breakdown, and the folding design offer convenient transport and compact storage. The workbench also features integrated shelf to provide storage for tools and materials, saving space and keeping everything within reach.
